name: Tuhinamshu Rath

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Tuhinamshu Rath is introduced in the journal’s contributor note as an Odia poet and sociology teacher associated with Jajpur. His contribution, “The Solar Path”, appears here in an English translation credited to Professor Raj Kishore Mishra. It joins the speaker’s survival to the continuing life of the earth.

Loss of sight, movement or physical strength does not extinguish dreams or the claim to dignity. The poem answers catastrophe with the ordinary persistence of building houses and imagining futures; even storms do not erase the Buddha’s smile. Its recurring movement towards sunlight makes hope an active practice. Creativity survives not because destruction is absent, but because the speaker refuses to let it have the last word.
